rows.delta_surface: while streamed backedge -> hot code-window refill
rows.finding: The new backedge exercises the refill seam and pays one refill per admitted iteration when it crosses the window. The window and Bank-2/3 code planes remain fixed raw storage outside the non-moving heap, so GC cannot relocate them.
rows.proof_boundary: This is a structural non-moving-GC exclusion, not a timing claim. The measured refill cost is documented separately.

rows.delta_surface: require fast path -> published C2D identity reads
rows.finding: The fast path is a serialized read-only decision before the parser. It neither opens a publication transaction nor writes C2D; every miss enters the unchanged slow path.
rows.proof_boundary: Excludes the new fast path from the GC/publication crossing. It does not re-prove the unchanged slow publication path.

rows.delta_surface: while non-local exit -> central abort landing
rows.finding: while adds only JFALSEREL/JMPREL control flow and no abort landing, C2J field, root or resident state. Errors and longjmp continue through the one implemented abort cleanup.
rows.proof_boundary: Fresh delta proof plus the existing 48-case central-unwind fixture; no new Link-77 open-transaction hardware claim.

rows.delta_surface: RUN/STOP inside while -> central abort landing
rows.finding: Link 77 physically aborts an active while through RUN/STOP and returns to a working REPL. The event consumer still calls the same C2J cleanup before longjmp; the delta adds no second abort path.
rows.proof_boundary: Hardware proves Link-77 ordinary RUN/STOP delivery and REPL survival. Byte-identical open-transaction restoration remains the previously reviewed central-landing proof; this receipt does not claim a fresh Link-77 transaction capture.

rows.delta_surface: require fast path -> C2D index/identity reads
rows.finding: The fast path reads only the published C2D index and identity through Prim 67. It introduces no source locator and no runtime Attic edge; misses fall back before any library load.
rows.proof_boundary: Structural source-domain exclusion. It makes no physical one-byte-DMA timing claim.

rows.finding: The new Ethernet, Auto-IEC and audio-DMA masks execute before window publication. The linked IRQ handler is byte-for-byte outside that change and retains no publication-state edge.
rows.proof_boundary: Fresh source/ELF ownership gate with 16/16 mutations plus hardware readback; no cartridge-storm support is claimed.

rows.delta_surface: new interrupt-source masks -> island install/handoff ordering
rows.finding: SEI precedes personality selection; masks and readbacks precede window publication; raster enable and CLI remain last. The relocated CRC is boot-only, has one pre-ownership caller and is unreachable after ownership.
rows.proof_boundary: Fresh linked-ELF ordering and closure proof. It does not expand the externally supported interrupt profile.

rows.delta_surface: interrupt ownership delta -> typed-queue break source
rows.finding: The Link-77 policy changes only pre-publication source masks. It leaves the matrix edge, pending/held latch, one queue consumer and source-less episode guard unchanged; the reviewed five-event queue-full model still rejects all sixteen source/model mutations.
rows.proof_boundary: Preserves the terminal C2.2 structural disposition and adds ordinary Link-77 RUN/STOP hardware confirmation. It does not rewrite history as a physical queue-full run on Link 77; none was performed in this delta review.

rows.finding: The cache is not a loaded-library authority. A hit requires the current generation, all five count/front values, the canonical index lock and the complete ordered persistent C2D identity; every mismatch takes the slow path.
rows.proof_boundary: Excludes stale fast-path acceptance. It does not claim that a changed generation can reuse the old cache.
